title: bn254-pairing-inversion: (6,2) STNFS, log phase metered at 2^96.7: 2^96.739599689

claims.statement: For the full-production bn254-pairing-inversion target, the algorithm of proof.md (with field-map.md, DESCENT.md, KERNELS.md, STORAGE.md) returns (P0,[x]Q0) with e(P0,[x]Q0)=z with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins, and expected total classical work E[W] <= 1+2^96.739599688 < 2^96.739599689 units (C=20,000 scalar AArch64 instruction equivalents), under heuristics H1-H4, H-EA, H-FFT, H-R, H-X, H-SEP and H5 (proof.md section 9). There is no run gate. Both individual logarithms run under one combined phase meter of 2^96.7 units that aborts as failure, so the ledger charges the logarithm phase at 2^96.7 in every run; the descent recurrence (expected 2^95.805191) enters only success, through Markov P(cap) <= (1+2^-13) E[D]/2^96.7 <= 0.537885, giving modeled success 0.458323. Each indivisible log-phase step is reserved at its priced bound and refused if it would exceed the meter, metering included (overhead factor <= 1+2^-13). Robustness: work side: none; success side: E[D] <= 2^95.89 (D the uncapped two-log work), with every other loss term at 10 times its modeled value. All preprocessing, failed trials, aborts, verification and output are charged once for this target; nothing is amortized over other targets.

experiments.purpose: Recompute the field, collection, filtering and cost-ledger arithmetic, including revised PGF-envelope descent and finite ECM-separation assumptions; the log phase is charged at its meter cap 2^96.7 and the descent model enters only success; rebuild returns rounded draft declarations. Arithmetic passes do not establish production hypotheses. part=pgf recomputes alpha=.5 PGF envelopes at psi=0..0.8 step .01 on all862 downward-rounded raw-mu toy observations; part=porttoy redoes an exact whole ball or parent/child/control from fixed seeds. These are scoped toy checks, not production proofs. Default{} also replays all862 PGF observations. part=bw config0..3 replays seven-pad positive/negative diagnostics; part=adaptive_stats recomputes all171entered-node PGF strata; part=adaptive,side,root_seed,order regenerates bounded recursive whole-ball evidence. These do not establish production relation saturation or uniform conditional transfer. Default also replays all171adaptive observations with downward-rounded rawmu; censored root outcomes remain unknown. part=threshold verifies the existing171 count tails for the corrected analytic inequality; it adds no empirical joint-law claim.
